An & that would read as a character reference in a link destination or title stays literal

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"?&amp;plus;\" title=\"&amp;plus;\">T</a>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
